name: BPSC
intro: BPSC captures your photograph live through the webcam. The signature image must be under 20 KB and taller than it is wide.

notes: The application captures a live photo through your webcam.
Face the camera with eyes open in good light, against a light background. No headgear, sunglasses or mask, and nobody else in the frame.
documents.label: Photograph

notes: Under 20 KB; 150–220 pixels wide and 250–320 pixels tall.
The image covers your signature in Hindi and in English; signing in both scripts one below the other suits this taller shape. Check your notification for the exact arrangement.
documents.label: Signature (Hindi and English)

faqs.q: Do I upload a photo for BPSC?
faqs.a: No. The BPSC application captures a live photo through your webcam. Only the signature is uploaded.

faqs.q: What is the BPSC signature size?
faqs.a: Under 20 KB, 150–220 pixels wide and 250–320 pixels tall.
